title: Facebook Marketplace Automation Bot Update v1.0.4
description:
• 🎨 Eye-Friendly High-Contrast Slate Navy Theme: Replaced murky dark colors with crisp Slate Navy palette, visible borders, clear input boxes, and glowing check indicators.
• 🚀 Bulk Listing 4-Phase Engine Fix: Resolved account selection, browser launch, and ThreadPool error handling for simultaneous multi-tab publishing.
• 🖼️ Direct Multi-Image File Selection: Added 'Select Images' direct file picker alongside folder loading.
• 🏷️ Condition Override & 1-Click Apply: Quick condition selector (New, Used - Like New, Good, Fair) with instant 'Apply to All'.
• 📍 Facebook Marketplace Buyer Region Injection: Configure and automate buyer location (City/ZIP and Radius) across accounts before publishing.
• 🛡️ Profile Manager Upgrades: 1-click 'Active' profile toggle switch, prominent 'Delete' buttons on cards and inside edit dialogs, and reliable Native Chrome launcher.
• 📦 Fast Windows Setup Wizard Installer: Fully packaged with Inno Setup 6 installer wizard.
